the-fool.name: The Fool
the-fool.meaning_up: Beginnings, innocence, spontaneity, a free spirit
the-fool.desc: The Fool stands at the precipice of a new journey, unaware of the challenges ahead. He embodies the spirit of boundless potential and the courage to take a leap of faith into the unknown. His presence signifies a time of new beginnings, where every step is an adventure and every moment is filled with wonder.
fortune_telling: You leapt before you looked, and it worked. That beginner's courage still runs through everything you've built since.
You're standing at the edge of something new. You don't need the full map. Take the step.
A fresh start is coming that will ask for openness, not expertise. Say yes while it's still a little scary.
fortune_telling_rev: You rushed in without checking the ground, and it cost you. That stumble taught you where the edges are.
Enthusiasm is carrying you past some obvious warning signs. Pause and look down before the next step.
A tempting leap is ahead. Check the landing first.

the-magician.name: The Magician
the-magician.desc: The Magician is a master of the elements, a conduit for the power of the universe. He represents the ability to manifest one's desires into reality through sheer willpower and resourcefulness. His presence signifies a time of immense power and the potential for inspired action.
fortune_telling: You once turned almost nothing into something real. That resourcefulness built the ground you stand on.
Everything you need is already on the table. Stop waiting for better tools and start working.
A moment is coming when your skills and an opportunity line up perfectly. Be ready to act fast.
fortune_telling_rev: Talent got scattered across too many half-finished tricks. Some of that power leaked away unused.
You have the skill but not the focus. Pick one thing and finish it.
Someone may soon promise more than they can deliver. Check the sleeves before you shake hands.

the-high-priestess.name: The High Priestess
the-high-priestess.meaning_up: Intuition, sacred knowledge, divine feminine, the subconscious mind
the-high-priestess.meaning_rev: Secrets, disconnected from intuition, withdrawal and silence
the-high-priestess.desc: The High Priestess is the guardian of the subconscious, a keeper of sacred knowledge and hidden mysteries. She represents the power of intuition and the importance of listening to one's inner voice. Her presence signifies a time of deep introspection and a connection to the divine feminine.
fortune_telling: You knew something before you could prove it, and you were right. That quiet knowing shaped your path.
The answer isn't out there. Sit still long enough and it will surface.
A truth will reveal itself soon, but only if you stop talking long enough to hear it.
fortune_telling_rev: You ignored a gut feeling and paid for it. The signal was there; the volume was down.
You're asking everyone's opinion except your own. Go quiet and listen inward.
Secrets nearby will try to stay secret. Trust what you sense over what you're told.

the-empress.name: The Empress
the-empress.desc: The Empress is the embodiment of the divine feminine, a symbol of fertility, creativity, and abundance. She represents the nurturing power of nature and the beauty that surrounds us. Her presence signifies a time of growth, both material and spiritual.
fortune_telling: Someone or something nurtured you generously, and it's still bearing fruit.
This is a season for tending, not forcing. Feed what you want to grow.
Something you planted is about to flourish. Make room for the abundance.
fortune_telling_rev: You gave so much away there was nothing left for you. That depletion still echoes.
You can't pour from an empty cup. Tend to yourself first today.
Growth ahead will stall if it's smothered. Care for it, then step back.

the-emperor.name: The Emperor
the-emperor.meaning_up: Authority, establishment, structure, a father figure
the-emperor.meaning_rev: Domination, excessive control, lack of discipline, inflexibility
the-emperor.desc: The Emperor is a symbol of authority and power, a ruler who brings structure and order to the world. He represents the importance of discipline and the rule of law. His presence signifies a time of stability and control.
fortune_telling: Structure, or someone who enforced it, gave your life its shape. The discipline stuck.
Chaos is asking for a plan. Draw the lines and hold them.
You'll soon be handed real authority. Rule it the way you'd want to be ruled.
fortune_telling_rev: Someone's iron grip left marks. You learned exactly what control costs.
You're gripping too hard. Loosen your hold before something snaps.
A power struggle is forming. Bring standards, not a hammer.

the-hierophant.name: The Hierophant
the-hierophant.meaning_up: Spiritual wisdom, religious beliefs, conformity, tradition, institutions
the-hierophant.meaning_rev: Personal beliefs, freedom, challenging the status quo
the-hierophant.desc: The Hierophant is a spiritual teacher, a guide who helps others find their own path to enlightenment. He represents the importance of tradition and the value of institutions. His presence signifies a time of learning and spiritual growth.
fortune_telling: Tradition and good teachers gave you your foundations. The old ways served you well.
Before you reinvent the wheel, ask someone who's rolled one. Convention has answers today.
A mentor or a time-tested path is about to appear. There's wisdom in walking it.
fortune_telling_rev: You broke with convention, and it made you who you are.
The rulebook isn't working. Write your own page.
You'll soon outgrow a doctrine. Leave respectfully, but leave.

the-lovers.name: The Lovers
the-lovers.meaning_up: Love, harmony, relationships, values alignment, choices
the-lovers.meaning_rev: Self-love, disharmony, imbalance, misalignment of values
the-lovers.desc: The Lovers represent the power of love and the importance of relationships. They symbolize the union of two souls and the harmony that comes from a deep connection. Their presence signifies a time of choices and the need to align with one's values.
fortune_telling: A bond you chose with your whole heart shaped everything after it.
This is about alignment, not just affection. Choose what matches your values.
A meaningful connection or crossroads is coming. Choose with your heart and your eyes open.
fortune_telling_rev: A misaligned bond, or a choice made half-heartedly, still trails behind you.
Something is out of tune between what you value and what you're doing. Retune it.
An easy option will tempt you away from the right one. Don't split the difference.

the-chariot.name: The Chariot
the-chariot.desc: The Chariot is a symbol of victory and success, a testament to the power of willpower and determination. It represents the ability to overcome obstacles and to achieve one's goals. Its presence signifies a time of action and forward momentum.
fortune_telling: You won by refusing to stop. That victory still fuels your confidence.
Grab the reins. Opposing forces will pull together if you steer with intent.
Momentum is building toward a win. Keep both hands on the reins.
fortune_telling_rev: You pushed hard in the wrong direction, and it took real strength to admit it.
You're revving without steering. Aim before you accelerate.
An obstacle ahead won't move by force. Redirect instead of ramming it.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: Strength is a symbol of inner power and courage, a testament to the ability to overcome any challenge with grace and compassion. It represents the importance of self-control and the power of a gentle heart. Its presence signifies a time of quiet confidence and inner resolve.
fortune_telling: You tamed something wild, in yourself or your life, with patience instead of force.
Gentle beats loud today. Lead with the soft hand.
A challenge is coming that muscle can't fix. Your calm will.
fortune_telling_rev: Doubt once made you fold when you had the strength to stay.
The inner critic is roaring. It's a house cat. Feed your courage instead.
Your patience will be tested. Don't mistake gentleness for weakness.

the-hermit.name: The Hermit
the-hermit.meaning_up: Soul-searching, introspection, being alone, inner guidance
the-hermit.desc: The Hermit is a symbol of introspection and solitude, a wise old soul who seeks knowledge from within. He represents the importance of taking time for oneself and of listening to one's inner guidance. His presence signifies a time of soul-searching and spiritual enlightenment.
fortune_telling: Time alone gave you an answer crowds never could.
Step back from the noise. Your lantern works better in the dark.
A stretch of solitude is coming, and it will be productive, not lonely.
fortune_telling_rev: You withdrew a little too far, and the world went on without you.
Reflection has become hiding. Take one step toward the door.
Isolation will tempt you. Take the wisdom, skip the exile.

wheel-of-fortune.name: Wheel of Fortune
wheel-of-fortune.meaning_up: Good luck, karma, life cycles, destiny, a turning point
wheel-of-fortune.meaning_rev: Bad luck, resistance to change, breaking cycles
wheel-of-fortune.desc: The Wheel of Fortune is a symbol of destiny and fate, a reminder that life is a constantly turning wheel of ups and downs. It represents the importance of accepting change and of going with the flow. Its presence signifies a time of great opportunity and a turning point in one's life.
fortune_telling: Luck spun your way once and rerouted everything.
The wheel is turning. Loosen your grip and ride it.
Circumstances are about to shift in your favor. Be ready to move when they do.
fortune_telling_rev: A bad turn of the wheel knocked you down. You got back up anyway, and that counts.
You can't stop the wheel, only your grip on it. Adapt.
A setback ahead is temporary. Resist it less and it passes faster.

justice.name: Justice
justice.meaning_up: Justice, fairness, truth, cause and effect, law
justice.desc: Justice is a symbol of truth and fairness, a reminder that all actions have consequences. It represents the importance of taking responsibility for one's choices and of living a life of integrity. Its presence signifies a time of accountability and a search for the truth.
fortune_telling: You got what your actions earned, for better or worse. The scales were honest.
Weigh it fairly, including your own part in it. Then decide.
A decision will land in your favor if your hands are clean. Keep them clean.
fortune_telling_rev: You were dealt something unfair, and it still tilts your scales.
Accountability is being dodged, maybe by you. Set the scales down evenly.
An imbalance will demand correcting. Tell the truth early; it's cheaper.

the-hanged-man.name: The Hanged Man
the-hanged-man.meaning_up: Pause, surrender, letting go, new perspectives
the-hanged-man.desc: The Hanged Man is a symbol of surrender and letting go, a reminder that sometimes the best course of action is to do nothing at all. He represents the importance of pausing and of seeing things from a new perspective. His presence signifies a time of sacrifice and a search for a new way of being.
fortune_telling: A pause you didn't choose turned out to be the point. It changed how you see.
Stop struggling. The view from here is the lesson.
A delay ahead is an upgrade in disguise. Surrender to it.
fortune_telling_rev: You hung on to a stalled situation long after it stopped teaching you.
This sacrifice isn't noble anymore, it's a stall. Cut yourself down.
You'll be tempted to keep waiting. Some doors only open when you let go.

death.name: Death
death.meaning_rev: Resistance to change, personal transformation, inner purging
death.desc: Death is a symbol of endings and beginnings, a reminder that all things must pass. It represents the importance of letting go of the old to make way for the new. Its presence signifies a time of great transformation and a transition to a new way of life.
fortune_telling: Something ended completely, and you grew back different. That ending made room for all of this.
Something is finishing. Hold the door for it.
A chapter will close soon. Grieve it properly, then travel light.
fortune_telling_rev: You kept something on life support long past its time, and it drained you.
You're resisting a change that has already happened. Loosen your grip.
Change will keep knocking until you answer. Open the door on your own terms.

temperance.name: Temperance
temperance.desc: Temperance is a symbol of balance and moderation, a reminder that all things should be done in harmony. It represents the importance of patience and of finding a middle ground. Its presence signifies a time of healing and a search for a sense of purpose.
fortune_telling: You found a middle path where others picked sides. That balance carried you.
Blend, don't binge. The right mix is subtle.
Patience and moderation will quietly win a situation that force would lose.
fortune_telling_rev: Excess of one kind or another threw you off balance, and you felt the wobble for a while.
Something is out of proportion. Pour a little back.
Extremes will look exciting soon. The middle path is still the fast one.

the-devil.name: The Devil
the-devil.meaning_up: Shadow self, attachment, addiction, restriction, sexuality
the-devil.meaning_rev: Releasing limiting beliefs, exploring dark thoughts, detachment
the-devil.desc: The Devil is a symbol of our shadow self, a reminder of the parts of ourselves that we keep hidden. He represents the importance of confronting our fears and of breaking free from our addictions. His presence signifies a time of temptation and a search for a sense of freedom.
fortune_telling: Something had its hooks in you. Naming it was the start of everything better.
Check the chains. Most of them are loose enough to slip.
A gilded trap is ahead. Enjoy the shine, skip the cage.
fortune_telling_rev: You broke a chain that others assumed was permanent.
Freedom is closer than it feels. One honest look at the habit and it loosens.
You're about to outgrow a vice or a bad bargain. Let it go all the way.

the-tower.name: The Tower
the-tower.meaning_up: Sudden change, upheaval, chaos, revelation, awakening
the-tower.meaning_rev: Personal transformation, fear of change, averting disaster
the-tower.desc: The Tower is a symbol of sudden change and upheaval, a reminder that all things are temporary. It represents the importance of being prepared for the unexpected and of embracing the chaos. Its presence signifies a time of great revelation and a spiritual awakening.
fortune_telling: Something collapsed suddenly, and the ground it cleared is where you're building now.
What's shaking was never stable. Save yourself, not the scaffolding.
A sudden shake-up is coming. It will only take what wasn't sound.
fortune_telling_rev: You saw the cracks early and got out before the crash. Quiet disasters count as wins.
You're propping up something that wants to fall. Controlled demolition beats collapse.
A crisis ahead can still be softened. Reinforce what matters and release the rest.

the-star.name: The Star
the-star.meaning_rev: Lack of faith, despair, self-trust, disconnection
the-star.desc: The Star is a symbol of hope and faith, a reminder that there is always a light in the darkness. It represents the importance of having a sense of purpose and of believing in oneself. Its presence signifies a time of renewal and a connection to the divine.
fortune_telling: After a hard stretch, hope found you again. It never really left.
You're healing. Keep it slow, keep it honest, keep looking up.
Relief and renewal are on the way. The wish you keep quiet is closer than you think.
fortune_telling_rev: A disappointment dimmed your hope for a while. The stars stayed put; you just stopped looking.
Cynicism is a cheap shield. Set it down for one evening and see.
When doubt creeps in, remember it's weather. The sky behind it hasn't moved.

the-moon.name: The Moon
the-moon.meaning_rev: Release of fear, repressed emotion, inner confusion
the-moon.desc: The Moon is a symbol of illusion and fear, a reminder that not all is as it seems. It represents the importance of listening to one's intuition and of exploring the subconscious mind. Its presence signifies a time of anxiety and a search for the truth.
fortune_telling: You walked a stretch of your story half in the dark, on instinct alone. It got you here.
Not everything is what it appears to be right now. Move slowly and trust your gut over the glare.
A confusing stretch is ahead. Instinct will read what logic can't.
fortune_telling_rev: A fog you lived in finally lifted, and the truth was kinder than the fear.
The fear is louder than the fact. Turn on a light and check.
Clarity is coming. What frightened you in the dark will look ordinary at dawn.

the-sun.name: The Sun
the-sun.meaning_rev: Inner child, feeling down, overly optimistic
the-sun.desc: The Sun is a symbol of positivity and fun, a reminder that there is always a reason to be happy. It represents the importance of living in the moment and of enjoying the simple pleasures of life. Its presence signifies a time of success and a feeling of vitality.
fortune_telling: A season of real joy warmed everything that came after.
It's a good day. Don't audit it. Enjoy it.
Bright days are coming: success, warmth, and nothing to decode.
fortune_telling_rev: A cloud parked itself over a happy time, and you learned that joy needs defending.
The sun is out and you're indoors. Step outside your own gloom for a minute.
Good news will arrive slightly late. Still good. Keep the curtains open.

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.meaning_rev: Self-doubt, inner critic, ignoring the call
judgement.desc: Judgement is a symbol of rebirth and renewal, a reminder that we all have the power to change our lives for the better. It represents the importance of listening to one's inner calling and of forgiving oneself for past mistakes. Its presence signifies a time of absolution and a new beginning.
fortune_telling: A wake-up call changed your course. You answered it, which is the part that matters.
Take stock honestly. Forgive the old version of you and get up.
A summons to something bigger is coming. Rise to it.
fortune_telling_rev: You judged yourself harder than any jury would have.
Self-doubt is drowning out the call. Lower the gavel and listen.
You'll get a second chance you don't think you deserve. Take it anyway.

the-world.name: The World
the-world.desc: The World is a symbol of completion and integration, a reminder that all things are connected. It represents the importance of celebrating one's accomplishments and of feeling a sense of wholeness. Its presence signifies a time of travel and a new chapter in one's life.
fortune_telling: You finished something whole. That completion is a foundation, not just a memory.
The circle is closing. Celebrate before you start the next one.
Completion is near, and it will feel as good as promised. The world opens after.
fortune_telling_rev: Something ended at ninety percent, and it still itches.
You're one honest push from done. Close the loop.
Don't stop at almost. The last mile is where the meaning lives.

ace-of-wands.name: Ace of Wands
ace-of-wands.meaning_rev: An emerging idea, lack of direction, distractions, delays
ace-of-wands.desc: The Ace of Wands represents a new spark of inspiration and a surge of creative energy. It's a sign of new beginnings and the potential for growth. This card encourages you to follow your passions and seize the opportunities that come your way.
fortune_telling: A spark of inspiration set your whole path burning.
That idea flickering right now is live. Strike while it's hot.
A jolt of creative fire is coming. Have kindling ready.
fortune_telling_rev: A promising spark fizzled for lack of air. It taught you how to tend the next one.
The idea is real; the direction is fuzzy. Aim before you ignite.
Delays will test a new venture. Keep the ember covered, not abandoned.

two-of-wands.name: Two of Wands
two-of-wands.meaning_rev: Fear of unknown, lack of planning
two-of-wands.desc: The Two of Wands signifies a moment of planning and decision-making. You have a choice to make that will shape your future. This card encourages you to explore your options and make a bold move.
fortune_telling: You once stood at the map and dared to plan bigger. That vision got you moving.
The world is wider than your current view. Plan the bolder route.
A choice between safe and vast is coming. Pack for vast.
fortune_telling_rev: You drew the map but never took the trip. The lesson traveled anyway.
Fear of the unknown is dressed up as prudence. Which is it, really?
You'll be tempted to settle for the smaller plan. Don't shrink the map.

three-of-wands.name: Three of Wands
three-of-wands.meaning_rev: Playing small, lack of foresight, unexpected delays
three-of-wands.desc: The Three of Wands represents progress and expansion. Your plans are in motion, and you are starting to see the results of your efforts. This card encourages you to look to the future with optimism and to be open to new opportunities.
fortune_telling: You sent your ships out early, and they've been coming back ever since.
Your efforts are already in motion. Watch the horizon, not your feet.
Returns on work already done are sailing in. Expansion follows.
fortune_telling_rev: You waited on returns that came late or small. Patience got a workout.
Progress is slower than the plan. Adjust the timeline, not the goal.
Obstacles may delay what you're owed. It still arrives; keep building the dock.

four-of-wands.name: Four of Wands
four-of-wands.meaning_rev: Instability at home, transitions, a canceled celebration
four-of-wands.desc: The Four of Wands is a card of celebration and homecoming. A foundation has been laid and it's holding. This card encourages you to mark the milestone with the people who helped you build it.
fortune_telling: You built something worth coming home to, and the welcome still stands.
A milestone deserves marking. Hang the garland today, not someday.
A homecoming or celebration is on its way. Sweep the porch.
fortune_telling_rev: A home that wobbled taught you what foundations are for.
The party feels premature because the base needs one more beam. Set it.
Plans for a gathering may shift. The people matter more than the date.

five-of-wands.name: Five of Wands
five-of-wands.meaning_rev: Avoiding conflict, tension release, finding common ground
five-of-wands.desc: The Five of Wands represents friction and competition. Everyone is swinging, nobody is aiming. This card encourages you to turn the scuffle into sparring. The energy is useful once it has rules.
fortune_telling: A rivalry sharpened you more than any easy win could have.
The chaos around you is mostly energy without rules. Give it rules.
A contest is coming. Practice like the others already are.
fortune_telling_rev: A fight you walked away from settled itself. You chose well.
The tension is ready to drain if someone lowers a stick first. Be someone.
A brewing clash can still become a collaboration. Offer the truce early.

six-of-wands.name: Six of Wands
six-of-wands.meaning_up: Victory, success, public recognition, progress, confidence
six-of-wands.meaning_rev: Private achievement, fall from grace, egotism, doubt
six-of-wands.desc: The Six of Wands is the victory lap. Your effort has been seen and named. This card encourages you to accept the recognition without apologizing for it, and to remember who rode beside you.
fortune_telling: You earned a win in front of witnesses, and it changed how you carry yourself.
The recognition is deserved. Wave back.
Applause is coming for work you've already done. Stand where they can see you.
fortune_telling_rev: A triumph nobody clapped for still counts. You know what it cost.
Doubt is crashing the parade. The win is real even if the crowd is quiet.
Recognition may arrive late or lopsided. Do the work for the work.

seven-of-wands.name: Seven of Wands
seven-of-wands.meaning_up: Challenge, protection, perseverance, defending your position
seven-of-wands.meaning_rev: Exhaustion, giving up, overwhelm, yielding ground
seven-of-wands.desc: The Seven of Wands shows you holding the high ground while challengers climb. This card encourages you to defend what you've built. You have the advantage, even if it doesn't feel like it.
fortune_telling: You held a position everyone said you'd lose. That's why you still have it.
You're above the fray, not beneath it. Hold the hill.
Challengers to something you built are coming. The high ground is yours; use it.
fortune_telling_rev: You yielded ground once and learned which hills are worth the fight.
Exhaustion is making surrender look like strategy. Rest first, decide after.
The pressure ahead will tempt you to drop the staff. Set it down deliberately or not at all.

eight-of-wands.name: Eight of Wands
eight-of-wands.meaning_up: Speed, swift action, movement, news arriving, momentum
eight-of-wands.meaning_rev: Delays, frustration, scattered energy, resisting change
eight-of-wands.desc: The Eight of Wands is all momentum: messages landing, plans accelerating, everything in flight at once. This card encourages you to move with the speed instead of bracing against it.
fortune_telling: Everything happened at once, and you caught most of it. That was the skill.
The air is full of arrows. Loose yours while the wind holds.
News and movement are inbound fast. Clear the runway.
fortune_telling_rev: A delay that infuriated you turned out to be aim.
Your energy is scattered across too many targets. Choose three, then one.
Things may stall just before takeoff. Check the fletching, not your worth.

nine-of-wands.name: Nine of Wands
nine-of-wands.meaning_up: Resilience, persistence, last stand, boundaries, grit
nine-of-wands.meaning_rev: Fatigue, paranoia, struggling on when rest is due
nine-of-wands.desc: The Nine of Wands is the second wind you didn't know you had. Battered but standing, this card encourages you to hold on. The last stretch is shorter than it looks from here.
fortune_telling: You've been knocked down before and got up anyway. That's your whole résumé.
You're more durable than today feels. One more hold.
A final push will ask for everything you have left. You have enough.
fortune_telling_rev: You mistook exhaustion for weakness once. It was just exhaustion.
Not everyone approaching is an enemy. Lower the guard an inch.
You may be tempted to quit a step from the finish. Sit down after the line, not before.

ten-of-wands.name: Ten of Wands
ten-of-wands.meaning_up: Burden, responsibility, hard work, completion in sight
ten-of-wands.meaning_rev: Carrying too much, burnout, delegating, release
ten-of-wands.desc: The Ten of Wands shows a full armload and a destination in view. The load is real and so is the finish. This card encourages you to carry only what's actually yours, and to put the rest down.
fortune_telling: You carried more than your share and it built the strength you use now.
Some of that armload isn't yours. Do an audit before you take another step.
The load gets heavier right before it's delivered. The door is close.
fortune_telling_rev: You finally put something down, and nothing collapsed. Remember that.
Burnout is a bill that always gets paid. Delegate before it's due.
Someone will offer to carry a bundle. For once, let them.

page-of-wands.name: Page of Wands
page-of-wands.meaning_up: Enthusiasm, exploration, free spirit, a spark of news
page-of-wands.desc: The Page of Wands is pure beginner's fire: curious, restless, and unafraid of looking new at something. This card encourages you to chase the interesting thing before the interesting thing cools.
fortune_telling: Your beginner's enthusiasm once opened doors expertise couldn't.
Curiosity is knocking. Answer it before it wanders off.
An exciting message or invitation is coming. Say yes first, plan second.
fortune_telling_rev: A false start embarrassed you into caution. The start was still right.
The passion is real but it's pacing in circles. Point it at something.
You'll hesitate at an open door. Hesitate walking through it instead.

knight-of-wands.name: Knight of Wands
knight-of-wands.meaning_up: Energy, passion, adventure, impulsive action, charisma
knight-of-wands.meaning_rev: Recklessness, haste, scattered force, a stalled charge
knight-of-wands.desc: The Knight of Wands charges first and reads the terrain later. Magnetic and fearless, this card encourages bold motion, with just enough rein to keep the horse pointed somewhere.
fortune_telling: A leap you took without looking landed better than the careful plans did.
The fire is up and the horse is saddled. Ride, but hold the reins.
An adventure will arrive with no itinerary. Go anyway.
fortune_telling_rev: A reckless charge cost you once. You kept the courage and lost the carelessness.
Speed without direction is just noise. Slow to a gallop.
You'll want to charge before scouting. Scout for one day, then charge.

queen-of-wands.name: Queen of Wands
queen-of-wands.meaning_rev: Self-doubt, jealousy, a dimmed flame, demanding moods
queen-of-wands.desc: The Queen of Wands runs warm: confident, generous with her fire, impossible to ignore. This card encourages you to take up your full space. Your light doesn't dim anyone else's.
fortune_telling: Someone's belief in you lit a torch you still carry.
You are at your most magnetic when you stop performing. Just burn.
A role that needs your particular warmth is coming. Accept it out loud.
fortune_telling_rev: A season of dimmed light taught you your flame was never the problem.
Comparison is stealing your heat. Close the window.
Doubt will whisper before your moment. Let it whisper to your back.

king-of-wands.name: King of Wands
king-of-wands.meaning_rev: Impulsiveness, domineering, a vision without follow-through
king-of-wands.desc: The King of Wands turns fire into direction. He doesn't just have the vision; he gets other people to see it too. This card encourages you to lead from conviction and let the details catch up.
fortune_telling: You once turned a wild idea into a working thing. People noticed.
The room is waiting for someone to decide. It's allowed to be you.
A leadership seat is opening. Take it before the committee forms.
fortune_telling_rev: A vision you couldn't land taught you that leading is mostly landing.
Conviction is tipping into steamrolling. Ask one real question today.
Follow-through will matter more than fireworks ahead. Finish something first.

ace-of-cups.name: Ace of Cups
ace-of-cups.desc: The Ace of Cups represents new beginnings in the realm of emotions. It's a symbol of love, compassion, and creativity. This card encourages you to open your heart and embrace the flow of feelings.
fortune_telling: A love or friendship arrived like weather and changed your whole climate.
Your cup is filling. Don't overthink it; drink.
New love, new warmth, or new compassion is heading your way. Leave the door unlatched.
fortune_telling_rev: You kept your cup covered while something real was pouring.
Feelings are backing up behind the dam. Let one out and see what happens.
An emotional opening will arrive disguised as an inconvenience. Open anyway.

two-of-cups.name: Two of Cups
two-of-cups.desc: The Two of Cups represents a deep connection between two people. It's a symbol of partnership, mutual respect, and love. This card encourages you to nurture your relationships and celebrate the bonds you share.
fortune_telling: A true partnership doubled what you could carry.
This connection is mutual. Meet it halfway, exactly halfway.
A meaningful bond is forming. What you give it, it gives back.
fortune_telling_rev: A bond fell out of balance, one cup always emptier than the other.
Someone is pouring more than the other. Level it or name it.
A small rift is ahead. Mend it while it's still small.

three-of-cups.name: Three of Cups
three-of-cups.meaning_rev: Independence, alone time, hardcore partying, 'three's a crowd'
three-of-cups.desc: The Three of Cups is a card of celebration and friendship. It represents a time of joy, creativity, and collaboration. This card encourages you to connect with others and share in the happiness of the moment.
fortune_telling: Your people showed up for you once, glasses raised. They made the hard parts lighter.
This calls for company. Gather your people and celebrate something minor on purpose.
A reunion or celebration is coming. Say yes and bring the good snacks.
fortune_telling_rev: The party ran long, or the circle ran shallow. You learned who stays for cleanup.
Too much noise, not enough nourishment. Trade the crowd for the two who matter.
Watch for a third wheel or an overbooked calendar. Guard the inner circle.

four-of-cups.name: Four of Cups
four-of-cups.meaning_up: Contemplation, apathy, reevaluation, a missed offer
four-of-cups.meaning_rev: Renewed motivation, acceptance, choosing to engage
four-of-cups.desc: The Four of Cups shows three cups you're tired of and a fourth you haven't noticed. This card encourages honest contemplation, but with your eyes open, because something is being offered right now.
fortune_telling: An offer you waved off came back around. Some cups are patient.
You're staring at what bores you while something new is held out. Look left.
A quiet offer is coming, easy to miss mid-sulk. Miss nothing this week.
fortune_telling_rev: The fog of apathy lifted once before, and the world was still there.
Your appetite for life is returning. Feed it something real.
Re-engagement is close. When the invitation lands, you'll actually want it.

five-of-cups.name: Five of Cups
five-of-cups.meaning_up: Loss, grief, regret, disappointment, dwelling on the spill
five-of-cups.meaning_rev: Acceptance, moving on, forgiveness, finding what remains
five-of-cups.desc: The Five of Cups grieves three spilled cups while two stand full behind it. The loss is real and so is the remainder. This card encourages mourning what's gone without forgetting what isn't.
fortune_telling: You lost something that mattered, and you survived the losing. Both are true.
Three cups are spilled; two are standing. You've counted the spill enough.
A disappointment may land soon. It will not be the whole table.
fortune_telling_rev: You finally turned around and found two full cups waiting. They'd been there the whole time.
Acceptance is arriving in pieces. Take each piece as it comes.
Forgiveness, of them or of yourself, is nearer than the grief admits.

six-of-cups.name: Six of Cups
six-of-cups.meaning_up: Nostalgia, childhood memories, innocence, reunion, gifts
six-of-cups.meaning_rev: Living in the past, rose-tinted glasses, moving forward
six-of-cups.desc: The Six of Cups is sweetness remembered: old friends, old places, the person you were before you got complicated. This card encourages you to visit the past like a garden: enjoy it, then come home.
fortune_telling: Something from childhood still steers you, gently and mostly well.
An old joy would fit in your life today. Reintroduce yourself to it.
Someone from your past is circling back. Greet them as who you both are now.
fortune_telling_rev: The good old days were also just days. Realizing that freed you.
Nostalgia is renting too much of your present. Give it a smaller room.
The past will call with a flattering offer. Check it against the present first.

seven-of-cups.name: Seven of Cups
seven-of-cups.meaning_up: Choices, fantasy, illusion, wishful thinking, options
seven-of-cups.meaning_rev: Clarity, decision, cutting through the mirage
seven-of-cups.desc: The Seven of Cups floats a banquet of options, and at least half are mirage. This card encourages you to want one thing on purpose. A chosen cup beats a cloud of maybes.
fortune_telling: Too many options once paralyzed you until choosing badly taught you to choose.
Half those glittering cups are smoke. Pick by weight, not shine.
A buffet of possibilities is coming. Decide your criteria before you see the spread.
fortune_telling_rev: The fog of maybes finally cleared, and one real cup remained.
Clarity is cutting in. Let it finish the job before you re-complicate things.
A decision you've been dreaming around will simplify itself soon. Ratify it.

eight-of-cups.name: Eight of Cups
eight-of-cups.meaning_up: Walking away, seeking deeper meaning, departure, letting go
eight-of-cups.meaning_rev: Fear of leaving, drifting back, one more try, avoidance
eight-of-cups.desc: The Eight of Cups leaves a full table by moonlight, not because it was bad but because it wasn't it. This card encourages the brave exit. Some searches only start when you stand up.
fortune_telling: You once walked away from something fine to look for something true. It was the right walk.
The table is set and your heart isn't at it. You already know.
A departure is approaching, yours or someone's. Pack light and bless the table.
fortune_telling_rev: You went back for one more try, and it answered the question for good.
Fear of leaving is not the same as a reason to stay. Sort the pile.
You may drift back toward an old door. Touch the handle and remember why you left.

nine-of-cups.name: Nine of Cups
nine-of-cups.meaning_rev: Smugness, inner emptiness behind the feast, unmet wishes
nine-of-cups.desc: The Nine of Cups is the wish card: the feast laid out and actually enjoyed. This card encourages you to notice satisfaction while it's happening instead of only in retrospect.
fortune_telling: A wish came true and you almost forgot to notice. You noticed just in time.
This is the good part. Sit in it for a full minute.
A wish is lining up to be granted. Be specific now, grateful later.
fortune_telling_rev: The feast that left you hungry taught you what you actually crave.
The display is impressive; the appetite is missing. Feed the inside first.
A wish may arrive in a plainer wrapper than you ordered. Open it anyway.

ten-of-cups.name: Ten of Cups
ten-of-cups.meaning_up: Harmony, family, lasting happiness, emotional fulfillment
ten-of-cups.meaning_rev: Strained bonds, an ideal cracking, misaligned homes
ten-of-cups.desc: The Ten of Cups is the rainbow over the household: connection that holds on ordinary days, not just good ones. This card encourages you to tend the people who feel like home.
fortune_telling: The people who feel like home didn't happen by accident. You built that.
The harmony around you is real. Stop auditing it for cracks.
A season of genuine contentment is forming. Let it be uncomplicated.
fortune_telling_rev: A picture-perfect ideal cracked, and something realer grew in the gap.
The postcard and the household disagree. Tend the household.
Small strains at home want attention before they want apologies. Attend early.

page-of-cups.name: Page of Cups
page-of-cups.meaning_up: Creative beginnings, intuitive messages, sensitivity, whimsy
page-of-cups.desc: The Page of Cups finds a fish in the goblet and says hello. Openhearted and a little strange, this card encourages you to take the whimsical impulse seriously. Wonder is a skill.
fortune_telling: A soft, odd impulse you followed once became something you love.
There's a fish in your cup. Say hello instead of sending it back.
A tender, unexpected message is coming. Receive it without irony.
fortune_telling_rev: A mood you outgrew used to make your decisions. It doesn't anymore.
The creative pipe is clogged with self-consciousness. Make something bad on purpose.
Feelings may run ahead of facts soon. Let them run; just don't hand them the wheel.

knight-of-cups.name: Knight of Cups
knight-of-cups.meaning_up: Romance, charm, an offer arriving, following the heart
knight-of-cups.meaning_rev: Moodiness, unrealistic promises, a proposal delayed
knight-of-cups.desc: The Knight of Cups rides in slowly, cup extended, meaning every word of it, today. This card encourages grand gestures given and received, with one eye gently open.
fortune_telling: An offer once arrived on a white horse, and accepting it changed things.
Lead with the heart today; it's better informed than usual.
An invitation or romantic overture approaches. Hear it out fully.
fortune_telling_rev: A beautiful promise that evaporated taught you to check for saddlebags.
The gesture is lovely; the logistics are missing. Ask about the logistics.
A charming offer ahead may be more mood than plan. Enjoy it; verify it.

queen-of-cups.name: Queen of Cups
queen-of-cups.meaning_up: Compassion, emotional depth, intuition, calm care
queen-of-cups.desc: The Queen of Cups holds everyone's feelings without spilling her own. Deeply intuitive, this card encourages compassion that includes yourself in its circle.
fortune_telling: Someone held your feelings once without flinching. You learned the trick from them.
Your intuition is running clean today. Trust the read.
Someone will need your particular calm soon. You'll have enough to share.
fortune_telling_rev: You drowned in feelings that weren't yours and learned to check the label.
You're absorbing the room again. Wring yourself out.
Caring ahead may tip into carrying. Hand back what isn't yours.

king-of-cups.name: King of Cups
king-of-cups.meaning_up: Emotional maturity, diplomacy, balance, steady counsel
king-of-cups.meaning_rev: Repression, manipulation, a storm behind the calm
king-of-cups.desc: The King of Cups keeps his throne steady on open water. Feeling everything and capsizing nothing, this card encourages mastery of emotion that doesn't require its denial.
fortune_telling: You stayed steady through someone else's storm once, and it mattered more than you know.
The waters are choppy and you are the keel. Steer gently.
You'll be asked to mediate soon. Your calm will be the deciding vote.
fortune_telling_rev: The calm you performed while sinking taught you to signal earlier.
Composure has quietly become suppression. Tell one person the truth.
A held-back feeling will want out at a bad moment. Schedule it a good one.

ace-of-swords.name: Ace of Swords
ace-of-swords.meaning_up: Breakthroughs, new ideas, mental clarity, success
ace-of-swords.meaning_rev: Inner clarity, re-thinking an idea, clouded judgement
ace-of-swords.desc: The Ace of Swords represents a moment of breakthrough and mental clarity. It's a symbol of new ideas, truth, and success. This card encourages you to think clearly and cut through the confusion to find the truth.
fortune_telling: One clear realization cut through years of fog.
The truth is sharp today. Use it precisely, not casually.
A breakthrough insight is coming. When it lands, act on it cleanly.
fortune_telling_rev: A half-truth or a muddled call left a mark.
Your thinking is cloudy. Don't swing the blade until it clears.
Beware a clever argument that cuts the wrong way. Sharpen first, then decide.

two-of-swords.name: Two of Swords
two-of-swords.meaning_up: Difficult decisions, weighing up options, an impasse, avoidance
two-of-swords.desc: The Two of Swords represents a difficult decision or an impasse. You are faced with a choice, but you may be feeling stuck or unable to see the way forward. This card encourages you to seek balance and make a decision with a clear mind.
fortune_telling: You once refused to choose, and the standoff held. Some peace is just a truce.
The blindfold is self-tied. Both options cost something; pick one and untie it.
A decision you've been dodging will circle back. Meet it with eyes open.
fortune_telling_rev: A dam of indecision finally broke, and the flood sorted out the truth.
The stalemate is cracking. Let it. Motion beats deadlock.
Delay is about to stop working. Choose before the choice is made for you.

three-of-swords.name: Three of Swords
three-of-swords.meaning_up: Heartbreak, emotional pain, sorrow, grief, hurt
three-of-swords.meaning_rev: Negative self-talk, releasing pain, optimism, forgiveness
three-of-swords.desc: The Three of Swords is a card of heartbreak and emotional pain. It represents a time of sorrow, grief, and hurt. This card encourages you to acknowledge your pain and allow yourself to heal.
fortune_telling: A heartbreak went clean through, and you healed around it. It's part of your architecture now.
This hurts because it mattered. Feel it properly; shortcuts scar worse.
A painful truth may land soon. It will hurt less than the not-knowing did.
fortune_telling_rev: An old wound finally started closing. You stopped re-reading the ending.
You're healing. Stop picking at the seam to check.
Forgiveness, given or received, is closer than it looks. Let the swords fall out.

four-of-swords.name: Four of Swords
four-of-swords.meaning_up: Rest, recovery, contemplation, a strategic pause
four-of-swords.meaning_rev: Restlessness, burnout, refusing to recover, stagnation
four-of-swords.desc: The Four of Swords lays the blades down and closes its eyes on purpose. Rest here is strategy, not surrender. This card encourages the deliberate pause that makes the next move possible.
fortune_telling: A rest you finally allowed yourself repaired more than you expected.
The pause is the strategy. Take it fully or not at all.
A quiet interval is coming. Bank the sleep; you'll spend it later.
fortune_telling_rev: Running on empty taught you the price of skipping the pit stop.
You're calling restlessness productivity again. Lie down.
Refusing to rest will soon make the decision for you. Choose it first.

five-of-swords.name: Five of Swords
five-of-swords.meaning_up: Conflict, a hollow victory, winning at a cost, discord
five-of-swords.meaning_rev: Reconciliation, making amends, ending the feud
five-of-swords.desc: The Five of Swords wins the argument and empties the field. Somebody collected all the swords and lost all the company. This card encourages you to count the full cost before claiming the victory.
fortune_telling: You won a fight once and stood alone on the field after. You remember the quiet.
You can win this exchange and lose the room. Price it out first.
A conflict ahead offers a trophy made of tin. Consider not collecting it.
fortune_telling_rev: An apology, given or received, ended a war nobody remembered starting.
The feud is running on momentum, not merit. Someone can stop; be someone.
A chance to make amends is approaching. Take it before pride reprices it.

six-of-swords.name: Six of Swords
six-of-swords.meaning_up: Transition, moving on, calmer waters ahead, passage
six-of-swords.meaning_rev: Resisting the move, unfinished business, rough crossing
six-of-swords.desc: The Six of Swords is the low ferry ride away from turbulence: not triumphant, just necessary. This card encourages the quiet crossing: the far shore really is calmer.
fortune_telling: You've made a hard crossing before. The water behind you proves it.
The boat is loaded and pointed at calmer water. Stay in the boat.
A transition is coming: unglamorous, necessary, and better on the other side.
fortune_telling_rev: The move you resisted for a year took an afternoon once you allowed it.
You're rowing back toward what you left. Turn the boat around.
Unfinished business will tug at the oars. Settle it before you cross, or release it.

seven-of-swords.name: Seven of Swords
seven-of-swords.meaning_up: Deception, strategy, acting alone, getting away with it
seven-of-swords.meaning_rev: Confession, conscience, coming clean, a plan exposed
seven-of-swords.desc: The Seven of Swords tiptoes off with an armload of blades and a backwards glance. Sometimes it's cunning, sometimes it's cutting corners. This card encourages you to ask which one you're doing.
fortune_telling: A corner you cut once still squeaks. You've cut fewer since.
Someone's strategy, maybe yours, has a hidden compartment. Check the luggage.
A sneaky maneuver is forming nearby. Count your swords before and after.
fortune_telling_rev: Coming clean once cost you less than carrying it did.
The conscience is louder than the plan. That's your answer.
A hidden thing is about to surface on its own. Beat it to the announcement.

eight-of-swords.name: Eight of Swords
eight-of-swords.meaning_up: Restriction, feeling trapped, self-imposed limits, victim mindset
eight-of-swords.meaning_rev: Freedom, new perspective, releasing the binds
eight-of-swords.desc: The Eight of Swords stands bound and blindfolded in a cage with no lock. The trap is real; the bars are mostly belief. This card encourages you to test the restraints. They're looser than they feel.
fortune_telling: A cage you finally tested turned out to be unlocked the whole time.
The binds are looser than they feel. Wiggle before you resign yourself.
You may feel cornered soon. Before panicking, inventory the actual walls.
fortune_telling_rev: The blindfold came off and the prison was a field. You walked.
Your perspective is widening. Let it finish before you redecide anything.
A release is coming, mostly because you'll stop renewing the lease on the cage.

nine-of-swords.name: Nine of Swords
nine-of-swords.meaning_up: Anxiety, sleepless nights, worry, dread, rumination
nine-of-swords.meaning_rev: Easing fear, perspective at dawn, asking for help
nine-of-swords.desc: The Nine of Swords is 3 a.m. with the whole catalogue of worries playing on loop. The swords are on the wall, not in you. This card encourages daylight math: most of tonight's dread won't survive breakfast.
fortune_telling: The disaster you lost sleep over mostly never came. Note the pattern.
It's 3 a.m. somewhere in your head. No verdicts until morning.
A worry spiral may visit soon. Book it a short stay, not a residency.
fortune_telling_rev: Saying the fear out loud once shrank it to carrying size.
Dawn is doing its work; the dread is losing altitude. Help it descend.
Relief is coming, faster if you tell one person what's circling.

ten-of-swords.name: Ten of Swords
ten-of-swords.meaning_up: Painful ending, rock bottom, betrayal, a chapter closed
ten-of-swords.meaning_rev: Recovery, regeneration, the worst is over, rising
ten-of-swords.desc: The Ten of Swords is overkill by design: ten blades where one would do, under a sky that's already brightening. This card encourages you to notice it's over. Endings this complete only point one direction: up.
fortune_telling: Something ended completely, and the completeness was the mercy.
It's done. Fully, dramatically done. Stop checking for an eleventh sword.
A hard ending approaches: final, and finally final. The sunrise behind it is included.
fortune_telling_rev: You already survived your worst day. It's back there, still ended.
You're getting up. Swords don't come with you; leave them in the ground.
Recovery is scheduled and gaining speed. The next chapter has no sequel hooks to this one.

page-of-swords.name: Page of Swords
page-of-swords.meaning_up: Curiosity, vigilance, new ideas, questions, mental energy
page-of-swords.meaning_rev: Gossip, scattered thoughts, all talk, hasty conclusions
page-of-swords.desc: The Page of Swords is up on the hill, blade drawn at every rustle, bursting with questions. This card encourages the sharp curiosity, pointed at facts, not at neighbors.
fortune_telling: A question you wouldn't stop asking eventually cracked something open.
Your curiosity is armed today. Point it at problems, not people.
New information is incoming. Verify it once, then wield it.
fortune_telling_rev: A rumor you repeated once came back wearing your name. Lesson kept.
The thoughts are scattering like startled birds. Pick one and follow it.
You'll be tempted to conclude early. Gather two more facts first.

knight-of-swords.name: Knight of Swords
knight-of-swords.meaning_up: Ambition, decisive action, speed, championing a cause
knight-of-swords.meaning_rev: Ruthlessness, charging unprepared, burnout by velocity
knight-of-swords.desc: The Knight of Swords rides at full gallop into the headwind, argument first. Unstoppable and occasionally unsteerable, this card encourages full commitment, after aiming.
fortune_telling: A cause you charged for at full speed actually moved because you did.
The wind is against you and you're galloping anyway. Just confirm the destination.
A moment demanding decisive speed is coming. Decide now what's worth the sprint.
fortune_telling_rev: A charge that flattened bystanders taught you to look down from the horse.
Velocity is masquerading as strategy. Pull up and read the map.
You'll want to bulldoze an obstacle that's actually a person. Dismount and talk.

queen-of-swords.name: Queen of Swords
queen-of-swords.meaning_up: Clear boundaries, honest perception, independence, wit
queen-of-swords.meaning_rev: Coldness, bitterness, cutting words, walls too high
queen-of-swords.desc: The Queen of Swords sees through everything and says so, kindly when possible. Her honesty is a public service. This card encourages clear eyes and clean boundaries. Warmth optional, truth not.
fortune_telling: A boundary you finally drew is the reason things work now.
You can see exactly what's happening here. Say it plainly and kindly, in that order.
A situation will need your unsentimental read. Deliver it; sugarcoat only the edges.
fortune_telling_rev: The wall that kept out the bad weather kept out the good too. You added a gate.
The wit is drifting toward the wound. Sheathe it for a day.
Bitterness will offer you its microphone soon. Decline politely.

king-of-swords.name: King of Swords
king-of-swords.meaning_up: Intellectual authority, truth, fairness, discipline, judgement
king-of-swords.meaning_rev: Cold logic, misuse of power, rigidity, a biased ruling
king-of-swords.desc: The King of Swords rules by principle and cuts by precedent. Feelings inform; they don't preside. This card encourages fair judgement, the kind you'd accept if it went against you.
fortune_telling: A fair call you made under pressure became someone's example of fairness.
You're the clearest head in the room. Rule accordingly, and rule yourself first.
A judgement call is coming to your desk. Decide it as if it will be quoted.
fortune_telling_rev: A ruling made without the heart's testimony had to be appealed. You reheard it.
The logic is airtight and the room is suffocating. Open a window.
Rigidity ahead will masquerade as principle. Check which one it is before enforcing.

ace-of-pentacles.name: Ace of Pentacles
ace-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Lost opportunity, lack of planning, poor financial control
ace-of-pentacles.desc: The Ace of Pentacles represents a new opportunity for prosperity and abundance. It's a symbol of manifestation, wealth, and security. This card encourages you to seize the opportunities that come your way and build a solid foundation for your future.
fortune_telling: A seed of real opportunity took root and held.
Something tangible is being offered. Take it with both hands.
A concrete opportunity is coming: money, work, or ground to build on. Plant it, don't pocket it.
fortune_telling_rev: An opportunity slipped through your fingers, and the lesson stayed.
Don't grip the coin so hard you can't catch the next one.
A shaky offer will glitter soon. Test the soil before you plant.

two-of-pentacles.name: Two of Pentacles
two-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Multiple priorities, time management, prioritisation, adaptability
two-of-pentacles.desc: The Two of Pentacles represents the need to balance multiple priorities and manage your time effectively. It's a symbol of adaptability and flexibility. This card encourages you to be organized and find a healthy work-life balance.
fortune_telling: You kept everything in the air when dropping something wasn't an option. That was skill, not luck.
You're juggling well, but juggle on purpose. Priorities are the actual trick.
More balls are incoming. Decide now which ones are allowed to bounce.
fortune_telling_rev: You dropped something because you were carrying too much. It happens to every juggler.
Overcommitment is coming due. Put one thing down gracefully.
The load ahead won't fit in two hands. Simplify before it decides for you.

three-of-pentacles.name: Three of Pentacles
three-of-pentacles.desc: The Three of Pentacles is a card of teamwork and collaboration. It represents a time of learning, skill-building, and successful implementation of plans. This card encourages you to work with others and learn from their expertise.
fortune_telling: Working with others, and being valued for your craft, built something that lasted.
This is collaboration weather. Show your work and let others make it better.
A team effort will showcase your skill. Bring your best stone to the cathedral.
fortune_telling_rev: A team pulling in three directions taught you what alignment is worth.
Everyone is building a different building. Compare blueprints today.
Credit or coordination may wobble ahead. Put the agreements in writing.

four-of-pentacles.name: Four of Pentacles
four-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Security, saving, control, holding on, conservatism
four-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Greed, hoarding, letting go, loosening the grip
four-of-pentacles.desc: The Four of Pentacles clutches its coins so tightly it can't shake hands. Security matters; circulation matters more. This card encourages you to hold what's yours without becoming the vault.
fortune_telling: The saving you did when it was hard is the floor you stand on now.
You're holding tight to something that would grow if it circulated. Loosen one finger.
A chance to secure your position is coming. Secure it, then keep your hands usable.
fortune_telling_rev: You finally let go of something clenched, and your hand worked again.
The grip has become the burden. Release is a form of wealth too.
You'll be asked to share or spend soon. The right amount will feel slightly brave.

five-of-pentacles.name: Five of Pentacles
five-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Hardship, scarcity, feeling left out in the cold, worry
five-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Recovery, aid accepted, the door was open, improvement
five-of-pentacles.desc: The Five of Pentacles trudges past a lit window, convinced it isn't invited. The hard season is real; so is the warm room. This card encourages you to knock. Help counts double when you accept it.
fortune_telling: A lean season taught you exactly what you can live without. Short list, wasn't it?
The window you're trudging past is lit for you. Knock.
A cold stretch may come. It has an end date and an open door halfway through.
fortune_telling_rev: Help you finally accepted turned out to be the whole turning point.
The thaw has started. Let people see you're still cold anyway.
Recovery is close, and it arrives faster with company. Accept the next hand offered.

six-of-pentacles.name: Six of Pentacles
six-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Generosity, charity, giving and receiving, fair exchange
six-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Strings attached, one-sided giving, debts of gratitude
six-of-pentacles.desc: The Six of Pentacles weighs generosity on honest scales: giving that dignifies, receiving that doesn't shrink. This card encourages you to keep the exchange flowing in both directions.
fortune_telling: Generosity you gave freely came back by a route you never predicted.
You're positioned to give or due to receive. Either way, keep the scales visible.
An exchange of help is coming. Give without ceremony; receive without apology.
fortune_telling_rev: A gift with strings taught you to read the packaging.
The giving has gone one-directional. Rebalance before resentment does the math.
An offer ahead may include invisible interest. Ask about the terms out loud.

seven-of-pentacles.name: Seven of Pentacles
seven-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Patience, long-term view, assessment, waiting for harvest
seven-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Impatience, sunk costs, misdirected effort, giving up early
seven-of-pentacles.desc: The Seven of Pentacles leans on the hoe and eyes the vine: growing, but slowly. This card encourages the honest assessment. Is it ripening or just rooted? Then wait, or replant, on purpose.
fortune_telling: Something you planted long ago is the thing quietly feeding you now.
The vine is growing at vine speed. Assess honestly, then let it grow.
A harvest is maturing. The worst move now is digging it up to check.
fortune_telling_rev: You once watered a dead plant out of stubbornness. You compost faster now.
Sunk cost is doing your gardening. Evaluate the vine, not the hours.
You'll itch to abandon something one season early. Get one more opinion first.

eight-of-pentacles.name: Eight of Pentacles
eight-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Craftsmanship, skill-building, diligence, mastery in progress
eight-of-pentacles.desc: The Eight of Pentacles is head-down at the bench, making the eighth one better than the seventh. This card encourages the unglamorous reps. Mastery is mostly attendance.
fortune_telling: The reps nobody saw you do are why it looks easy now.
This is bench time. One more careful repetition beats three rushed ones.
Your skill is about to compound. Keep showing up; the eighth coin shines.
fortune_telling_rev: Perfectionism once kept a good piece on the bench forever. You shipped the next one.
The repetition has gone hollow. Vary the work before you resent it.
You'll be tempted to cut a corner that holds the whole frame. Don't.

nine-of-pentacles.name: Nine of Pentacles
nine-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Overwork behind the garden, hollow status, dependence
nine-of-pentacles.desc: The Nine of Pentacles strolls its own garden, grapes ripe, falcon calm. Everything here was earned. This card encourages you to actually enjoy what your discipline built.
fortune_telling: The independence you built coin by coin is real. Walk your own garden and count.
You earned this comfort. Enjoying it is not a lapse in discipline.
A season of earned ease approaches. Practice receiving it gracefully.
fortune_telling_rev: A luxury that impressed everyone but you clarified what wealth is for.
The garden is gorgeous and you're too busy tending to stroll it. Stroll.
Check what the fine things ahead are for. Buy the ones that buy back time.

ten-of-pentacles.name: Ten of Pentacles
ten-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Legacy, family wealth, long-term security, inheritance
ten-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Family disputes over resources, short-term thinking, fragile foundations
ten-of-pentacles.desc: The Ten of Pentacles is the archway generations walk through: wealth that outlives its maker. This card encourages building for people you may never meet.
fortune_telling: Someone before you built the archway you walked in through. You're mid-build on the next one.
Think in decades today. The compounding has already started.
Something you establish soon will outlast you. Set the cornerstone square.
fortune_telling_rev: A squabble over the inheritance taught you what the inheritance actually was.
Short-term thinking is nibbling the foundation. Repour where it's thin.
A resource dispute may surface in the family or the team. Write things down early.

page-of-pentacles.name: Page of Pentacles
page-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Studiousness, new skills, ambition grounded, an opportunity to learn
page-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Procrastination, a stalled course, dreaming without doing
page-of-pentacles.desc: The Page of Pentacles turns the coin over and over, already imagining what it could become. This card encourages the student's posture: begin small, study close, build real.
fortune_telling: A skill you started badly is now one you're known for. Beginnings forgive.
You're holding a coin that wants to be studied, not spent. Enroll.
A chance to learn something bankable is coming. Take the notes by hand.
fortune_telling_rev: The course you never finished still taught you how you don't learn. Useful.
The dreaming has lapped the doing. Convert one fantasy into one task today.
Procrastination will offer you a very reasonable extension. Refuse it.

knight-of-pentacles.name: Knight of Pentacles
knight-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Stagnation, boredom, stuck in a rut, over-caution
knight-of-pentacles.desc: The Knight of Pentacles rides the slowest horse and arrives every single time. This card encourages the steady method. Boring is a strategy with an excellent record.
fortune_telling: Showing up every day, unglamorously, is what actually got you here.
Slow and steady isn't the backup plan; it's the plan. Ride on.
A long task ahead will reward the plodder. Be the plodder proudly.
fortune_telling_rev: A rut you mistook for a routine finally announced itself. You changed the route.
The routine has stopped serving and started sedating. Vary one thing.
Over-caution may cost you a good opening soon. Trot, just this once.

queen-of-pentacles.name: Queen of Pentacles
queen-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Nurturing practicality, resourcefulness, comfort, grounded care
queen-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Self-neglect while providing, smothering, work-home imbalance
queen-of-pentacles.desc: The Queen of Pentacles keeps the garden fed, the books balanced, and the door open. Care, here, is competence. This card encourages providing in ways that include the provider.
fortune_telling: Someone made a warm, working world around you once. You've been paying it forward since.
Your practicality is a form of love. Apply a serving to yourself today.
People will gather where you've made things work. Set an extra place.
fortune_telling_rev: Running the household on an empty tank taught you where the fuel gauge is.
Everyone's fed but you. Sit down at your own table.
The urge to manage everyone's garden is coming. Tend yours first this week.

king-of-pentacles.name: King of Pentacles
king-of-pentacles.meaning_up: Abundance, business acumen, security, a steady hand on wealth
king-of-pentacles.meaning_rev: Greed, materialism, controlling with money, stubborn empire
king-of-pentacles.desc: The King of Pentacles built the vineyard, kept the books, and still walks the rows. Wealth, matured into stewardship. This card encourages the long game played generously.
fortune_telling: Discipline you practiced young became an estate you barely notice holding.
Your judgement on practical matters is at full strength. Make the big call.
A venture with real roots is coming to your table. Fund what feeds people.
fortune_telling_rev: An empire held too tightly taught you the difference between owning and gripping.
The ledger is winning arguments the heart should get. Recuse the ledger once.
Money may try to do your talking soon. Speak first, spend second.
